justification: Both show low-relief carving that includes curved raised bands and small circular discs applied to a body, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A depicts a detailed profile bird- or dragon-headed creature filling a rectangular field with a beaked head, eye, mane of scale-like feathers and a clawed limb, while B depicts a frontal, blocky anthropomorphic figure with a head, torso and abstract chest and belt-like markings; neither the subject, posture, viewpoint nor arrangement corresponds.
